machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

implementation.before: Every transformer block owned, committed, and waited for its own command buffer.
implementation.cache_off_after: All 32 transformer blocks encode into one caller-owned command buffer and the host waits once per denoising step.
implementation.cache_dit_after: Block 0 remains a separate command buffer because its residual must be read by the host cache decision. On full steps, blocks 1-31 encode into one tail command buffer; cached steps still stop after block 0.
implementation.profiling_fallback: QI_PROFILE_CACHED_BLOCK retains the per-block wrapper and timing path.

interpretation: The optimization removes repeated host waits and command-buffer submission gaps, but does not reduce transformer arithmetic. Cache-off loop wall time improves by 458 ms while summed GPU time is effectively unchanged. Cache-DiT benefits less because cached steps already execute only block 0 and every full step still requires a block-0 readback before its batched tail.
